rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose description of someone who lacks musical ability.

example.english: They are unmusical and can never keep up with the beat.
example.traditional: 佢完全冇音樂天分，連拍子都成日跟唔到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 jam1 ngok6 tin1 fan6 lin4 paak3 zi2 dou1 sing4 jat6 gan1 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone cannot sing in tune, rather than for every kind of musical inability.

example.english: They are unmusical when they sing, and everyone cannot help laughing.
example.traditional: 佢唱歌五音不全，成班人都忍唔住笑。
example.jyutping: keoi5 coeng3 go1 ng5 jam1 bat1 cyun4 sing4 baan1 jan2 dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3

rows.note: Use this for a tune or piece that sounds unmelodic or unpleasant to listen to.

example.english: This song is so unmusical that I can never get used to it, no matter how many times I hear it.
example.traditional: 呢首歌個旋律真係唔入耳，聽幾多次都唔慣。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau2 go1 go3 syun4 leot6 zan1 hai6 m4 jap6 ji5 teng1 gei2 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 gwaan3
